title: Noyonmoni
desc: Nayan's house catches fire after he is born, which makes people believe that he is a bad omen. His life changes drastically when his father is arrested.

title: Ekai Eksho
desc: Ratan, an honest autorickshaw driver, refuses to help a corrupt politician, Pradip Roy, which then leads to a local war. He also ends up falling in love with Jhilik, his daughter.

title: Sindoor Niye Khela
desc: Varsha is a powerful businesswoman, but faces opposition from her workers. In order to solve the problem, she marries the leader of the worker's union.

title: Mahajan
desc: A powerful landowner conducts his business and lives his life with cruelty. However, various circumstances influence him to change his nature and tactics over time.

title: Beder Meye Josna
desc: A prince, bitten by a snake, is saved by the healer Josna, who falls ill in the process. Recovered, she demands his hand in marriage, leading to a royal tug-of-war for love.
